note: The attacker-controlled encap action field selects the decode path and carries the malformed action payload into the vulnerable decoder.
The decoder copies header-size metadata from the input action into the heap object that will later be finalized and used.

The decoder must preserve a valid remaining property length while advancing through TLVs; malformed length bookkeeping violates that safety obligation and leads to use-after-free during property decoding.
The property decoder consumes the action buffer through the advancing pointer/length pair and performs the invalid write on freed or invalidated state.
